newsitem.title: USA: Sunglass Hut stake held by FMR-led group.
newsitem.headline: Sunglass Hut stake held by FMR-led group.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp on Thursday said it held a 9.11 percent stake in Sunglass Hut International Inc, or 5,002,269 common shares.
The group disclosed its latest position on Sunglass in a 13G filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. FMR Corp is the parent of the investment adviser to Fidelity Funds.

Filings under 13G are usually made by institutions and large investors with passive investment objectives in a company. IN contrast with 13D filings, those reports do not list the latest transactions.
The Coral Gables, Fla., company is a specialty retailer of non-prescription sunglasses. It operates stores in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, the Caribbean and Mexico.
